extraction_notes: The ordering information identifies 2N7002WT1G as the SC-70 lead-free orderable covered by the 2N7002W datasheet from onsemi.
Curve points are manual readings from the plotted traces on pages 3 and 4 and are approximate digitizations, not interpolated values.
The transfer plot does not state its VDS test voltage. Only the TJ = 25 degC trace was digitized; the TJ = 125 degC and TJ = -55 degC traces were not separately extracted.
The output plot traces labelled VGS = 6 V through 10 V overlap heavily near the upper-left region and were not separately digitized.

The table provides no typical threshold voltage, no gate resistance, and no reverse-recovery time. The body-diode specification stores the 25 degC maximum 1.2 V; the table also lists a 25 degC typical 0.8 V and an 85 degC typical 0.7 V.
The capacitance plot is labelled TJ = 25 degC and VGS = 0 V; its x-axis represents gate-source or drain-source voltage as printed in Figure 7.
extraction.omission_reason: The transfer plot does not state VDS, and only its 25 degC trace was digitized. The output traces labelled VGS = 6 V through 10 V overlap heavily and were omitted as separate curves.
